Fills the inn with ambient mana, like a leyline: mages cast almost twice as many spells. The mana effect is not modelled (no effects).
The name is confirmed; the effect (food kept fresh) is a guess from a cut apple left to see. Not modelled.
M17.4: Lyonette gets it as a [Barmaid] (2.42), Geneva has it (1.01D), a [Warrior] gets it at level 1. It keeps you going longer; +1 AP per turn is the user's rule (ADR 0022).
M17.4: Erin gets it at [Innkeeper] level 9; what she throws hits where she aims. A throw of the held item that never misses; AP and cooldown are design numbers.
M17.4: Durene uses it; a basic fast attack. A plain blow for 1 AP instead of 2, once a round.
M17.4: Relc's rare [Spearmaster] Skill: three thrusts in one attack. Three blows for 4 AP; numbers are design.
M17.4: only the name is in the text (a fighter's Skill in 1.58H). A spinning cut at every foe around you is a guess from the name.
M17.4: Toren's blurred cut that is hard to see or block. NPC only (no pool).
M17.4: Erin's [Power Strike] changes into it in 2.26. NPC only (no pool): the change of a Skill is not modelled for the player.
M17.4: [Runners] use it in a race for a burst of speed. +1 AP of movement this turn for 0.5 AP.
M17.4: Erin gets it at [Innkeeper] level 18; only the name is in the text. A quarter of max HP back in a fight is a guess.
